Exercise 7. Umm Šarīf: wakes up very early, before dawn, and prays · prepares breakfast for her husband and Yāsmīn · at noon goes to the market · kitchen lunch · in the evening watch TV and call Šarīf. Yāsmīn: wakes up at the 6:45 · Fast breakfast: tea, bread and cheese · lessons from 9 to 14 · Lunch at home at 16 · In the evening he studies. ʿAmm Fatḥi: the shop opens to 10 and closes to 22 · Breakfast in the shop · Lunch with a sandwich · On Fridays the shop is closed and stays with children. Exercise 8. a) In Milan at seven; in Egypt very late. Coffee and something simple (in Egypt fūl and ṭaʿmiyya). In metre; lessons range from 9 to 13. At the cafeteria: it's not bad, but not like Mom's kitchen. She studies until 10:00 and then calls the family on video. Because he works shifts, sometimes at night. Every day at least half an hour, even on the subway. b) Economics at the University of Cairo. In the metro from Shubra and then on foot; About an hour for the riot. He reads or listens to songs. It depends: sometimes at four o'clock, sometimes it stays in a coffee with friends until sunset. Because Mom's waiting for her for lunch; Yāsmīn responds that it is Šarīf not to call her enough. For voice parts A and B, the tutor accepts the natural variants of the fast talk and removes the point if the b- in a present or if the form is fuṣḥā.
